What I do

01Creative production

  • Marketing services

    Campaign concepts, messaging and content planning built around what each audience needs to hear.

  • Video editing

    Shaping footage, sound and pacing into stories for social, campaigns and longer formats.

  • Design

    Visual direction, campaign graphics and layouts that carry an idea consistently across formats.

  • Shoots

    Planning and capturing photo and video for brands, people, spaces and live events.

  • Short films

    Developing narrative ideas and carrying them through production, editing and the final cut.

02Development & hardware

  • Web development

    Responsive websites, from portfolio and campaign pages to interactive web experiences.

  • App development

    Turning product ideas into apps with clear interfaces and practical workflows.

  • Custom software

    Building tools around specific needs, including plugins, utilities and workflow automation.

  • Camera rigs

    Designing and building camera setups around the movement, mounting and handling a shoot needs.

  • Electronics

    Prototyping and assembling electronic systems for custom hardware and creative projects.
